definition.simple: A community of living things interacting with their environment.
definition.academic: A biological community of interacting organisms and their physical environment.

common_misconceptions: Ecosystems are only large things like oceans or forests. (False, a small puddle can also be an ecosystem.)
ai_context.tutor_hint: Remind students that non-living things like sunlight, rocks, and water are also crucial parts of the ecosystem.
